home.tagline: Book a real office. See how it could fit you.
home.sub: Every office below is a real listing with real photos. Pick one, see AI fit concepts from its own room, then book by chat.
home.decorative: Decorative illustration — not a real listing
home.realNote: Photos on these cards come from each listing itself. Anything illustrated on this page is decoration only.
home.step1Body: A short phone video is enough. We pull keyframes, estimate specs, and write the listing in Arabic and English.
home.step2Body: First the room as it is today, then AI fit concepts — startup, clinic, training — rendered from that same room.
home.step3Body: Ask in Egyptian Arabic, pick a day, add cafe coffee, and pay. No forms marathon.
home.fitTitle: Bare room in, fitted office out
home.fitBody: Semifinished spaces rent for less because you finish them. Our fit concepts show what the exact room could hold before you commit — they are concepts, not the current state.
home.ownerBody: Film a short walkthrough and we build the listing — specs, bilingual copy, and fit concepts included.
upload.title: List your office
upload.videoHint: Pick a short walkthrough video (max 45 seconds, 80 MB). Frames are extracted in your browser.
upload.failed: Something went wrong, please try again
edit.title: Review & edit specs
edit.note: Any edit you make is marked as owner-edited.
unit.synthetic: Demo listing — AI-generated photos, not a filmed office
viewer.fitNote: Fit renders are AI concepts from the real room — not the current state.
booking.name: Name
booking.longTermNote: Bare/semifinished: you do the final fit-out, lower rent. See the fit concepts above, then chat to arrange.
chat.title: Chat to book
chat.subtitle: Talk in Egyptian Arabic as usual. The agent can add cafe coffee to your booking.
chat.greeting: Welcome to Offisio. What kind of office are you looking for, where, and for when?
chat.placeholder: Type here… e.g. I want an office tomorrow in Cairo, add a cappuccino
bookingPage.title: Your booking
bookingPage.note: Your booking is confirmed only after payment confirmation is received. Returning from the payment page alone is not a confirmation.
error.RATE_LIMITED: You've reached today's demo limit for this from your device. Try again tomorrow, or browse the ready listings.
error.DEMO_QUOTA: Demo quota reached for today for this feature. Browsing, booking and payment keep working.
error.MESSAGE_TOO_LONG: That message is too long. Please keep it under 800 characters.
error.SESSION_FULL: This chat has reached its length limit. Reload the page to start a new one.
error.VIDEO_TOO_LONG: The video is longer than 45 seconds. Please use a shorter walkthrough.
error.VIDEO_TOO_BIG: The video is larger than 80 MB.
error.DATE_IN_PAST: That day has passed. Pick an upcoming one.
error.SLOT_TAKEN: That day was just booked. Pick another one.
error.INVALID_PHONE: Use an Egyptian mobile number: 11 digits starting with 01.
error.BOOKING_NOT_PAYABLE: This booking can no longer be paid (its 30-minute hold expired). Please book again.
upload.autoHero: AI picks the best frame for each room
unit.usesNote: Based on the layout seen in the walkthrough video only, not a licensing check.
stage.title: Render fit-out concepts
stage.note: One click per use. Each render takes about 30 seconds.
error.STYLE_NOT_IN_PLAN: That fit-out isn't planned for this unit's layout.
viewer.rooms: {n} rooms in this fit, tap to switch
upload.locationHint: Paste the Google Maps link of the office (Share → Copy link), or type lat, lng.
error.LOCATION_INVALID: We couldn't read a location in Egypt from that. Paste a Google Maps link or lat, lng (e.g. 30.0609, 31.2194).
pipeline.title: Listing progress
pipeline.note: Your listing goes live after the listing step; fit-out renders fill in afterwards. Each step runs on its own, so one failure does not stop the others.
error.NOT_RETRYABLE: That step is not in a failed state.
meta.siteTitle: Offisio — Book real offices in Cairo
meta.siteDescription: Real offices with real photos. See AI fit concepts rendered from each room, then book by chatting in Egyptian Arabic or English.
meta.ogAlt: Offisio — book real offices by chat
meta.chatDescription: Tell the Offisio agent what you need in Egyptian Arabic or English. It finds a matching office, checks free days, adds cafe coffee and sends a payment link.
meta.uploadDescription: Film a short walkthrough of your office. Offisio estimates the specs, writes the listing in Arabic and English, and renders fit concepts from the same room.
